newsitem.title: USA: Jake's Pizza makes offer to settle debt.
newsitem.headline: Jake's Pizza makes offer to settle debt.

text.p: Jake's Pizza International Inc said Tuesday it has made a proposal to 17 of its largest unsecured creditors to settle an outstanding debt of $470,965 for $117,742 as payment in full.
It said as of December 27, two creditors had refused the proposal and one had not made a decision. The balance related to these creditors amounts to $104,084.

Jake's said it anticipates disbursing the funds to the creditors by January 31, 1997. It said most of the funds to pay creditors will come from the sale of the company's current office/warehouse (expected in early January), through postponement of a $100,000 payment on the second mortgage note to a related party.

Jake's reiterated that it believes it will need 65 to 70 healthy operating franchised restaurants to bring the company to a break-even cash flow. As of December 27, there were 50 Jake's Pizza restaurants operating nationally, including two company-owned restaurants.
The company will relocate into a new headquarters in Rolling Meadows, Ill.. effective January 6.
